Business Certificates
Applying for a Business Certificate
Non-Agricultural Business in a Residential Zoning District:
Apply for Zoning Approval using:
https://permiteyes.us/westport/loginuser.php
Please contact the building department for more information at 508-636-1035
Complete the form
"Business Certificate Form - New and Renewal"
.
Applications must be signed in the presence of a notary or the town clerk with ALL business owners present.
Fee: $60.00 (check or cash only)
Applications (with the approved zoning application) may be brought to the Town Clerk to be filed OR may be mailed to the office for filing but must include a self-addressed, stamped envelope.
Agricultural Businesses and/or Businesses in a Business District:
Zoning Approval is not required.
Complete the form
"Business Certificate Form - New and Renewal"
.
Applications must be signed in the presence of a notary or the town clerk with ALL business owners present.
Fee: $60.00 (check or cash only)
Applications may be brought to the Town Clerk to be filed OR may be mailed to the office for filing but must include a self-addressed, stamped envelope.
Certificate Renewals follow the process as above and Zoning Approval is not required unless the location has changed.
